title: This Might Be the Easiest Way to Sell AI to Businesses
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: GoHighLevel tutorial; Slybroadcast mentioned as 'not an ad'

stated_problem.quote: As of right now, most small businesses are letting calls go to voicemail and hoping people call back.
stated_problem.speaker: Chris Koerner

idea.name: AI missed-call text-back agent for small businesses
idea.one_liner: Build a GoHighLevel workflow where an AI agent texts back missed callers, holds a two-way conversation and books estimates, then sell it to local trades found via Outscraper and ringless voicemail drops that trigger the same text-back
idea.customer: local service businesses (tree trimmers, plumbers, HVAC)
idea.offer: done-for-you AI missed-call text-back and appointment booking
idea.revenue_model: monthly retainer $500-2,000 per client with 90-day money-back guarantee

key_quotes.quote: So, today, I'm going to build an AI agent that texts back missed calls automatically.
Now that you have this one workflow, you can copy and paste it over and over and over for multiple customers.
It is $500 a month, but if it doesn't pay for itself in the first 90 days, then I'll give you all your money back.

claims.claim: 57% of sales go to first responder
claims.quote: 57% of sales goes to whoever responds first. And that's not my opinion.
This is a $500 to $2,000 a month per client service.

claims.claim: A 16-year-old landed a plumber client via ringless voicemail
claims.quote: I use ringless voicemail drops to find a plumber that wants AI integrated into his business." And I got it on my 16th birthday.

claims.claim: Live test produced a callback conversation but no close yet
claims.quote: So, I haven't closed them yet. I don't have money in my pocket yet from this, but you can see that this works.

acquisition_channels.details: scrape business phone numbers via Outscraper, drop vague voicemail via Slybroadcast, callbacks trigger the AI sales text-back (dogfooding)
AI books call with hot leads

ideas.delivery: GoHighLevel missed-call template; replace static SMS with Conversation AI; prompt written by Claude per niche; branches for booked/emergency/unqualified; push/SMS notifications to owner; duplicate per client

uk_legal_risk.reason: Ringless voicemail drops are automated marketing calls; PECR requires prior consent for automated calls even to businesses; AI text-backs need to be transparent

ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR on scraped contact data; check TPS/CTPS
